description: Editable inputs copied without rounding from the October 21, 2026 current-hull run. No live CAD import.

mass_kg.meaning: Total loaded mass; recorded as 125.249 lb

deadrise_deg.meaning: Equivalent V: degrees(atan(1.403 / 6)); curved bottom approximated

vcg_m.meaning: CG above aft keel datum; 6.079 in

thrust_height_m.meaning: Point on shaft line, above keel; negative = below datum

thrust_x_m.meaning: Point on shaft line, forward of transom; negative = aft

thrust_angle_deg.meaning: Upward forward thrust angle relative to keel

roughness_m.meaning: Zero = smooth-hull assumption, disables roughness allowance

wetted_lengths_type.meaning: 2 = Savitsky 1964; this notebook supports only this geometry

flap_chord_m.meaning: Zero; this notebook supports no flap

flap_span_ratio.meaning: Zero; this notebook supports no flap

flap_angle_deg.meaning: Zero; this notebook supports no flap

assumptions: Equivalent constant V-bottom: atan(1.403/6) = 13.161 degrees; curved section with 5-degree keel slope is not represented exactly.
Aft 38 inches assumed uniform; all solved points predict wetting beyond this section. No clipping of predicted wetting.
Freshwater 20 C, density 998.2 kg/m3, viscosity 1.004e-6 m2/s.
Smooth hull: roughness allowance zero. Fully turbulent ITTC friction; actual finish unknown.
No displacement/wave-making resistance, appendage drag, air drag, propeller interaction, waves or dynamic stability model.
Total thrust is along both shafts combined. Per-prop figures assume equal thrust. Effective power is horizontal resistance times speed, not motor shaft or battery power.
CAD +Y forward, +Z up; aft keel assumed parallel to top plane; transverse CG offset 0.004 in ignored in symmetric calculation.
Cv<1 cutoff is not a prediction of planing onset.
